description: Use this when the user asks about today's agenda, today's tasks, what they are doing today, or what they should do today. Includes tasks, plans, Google/calendar events, and an overdue summary.

householdId.description: Optional Familia household id. Omit to use all accessible households.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, e.g. Europe/Prague. Defaults to ASYNQ_TIMEZONE or runtime timezone.

name: familia_get_today_schedule
title: What am I doing today?
